<parameter name="command">python3 << 'EOF'
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Start date: Friday, January 27, 2006
start_date = datetime(2006, 1, 27)
print(f"Start date: {start_date.strftime('%A, %B %d, %Y')}")

# Add 986 days
end_date = start_date + timedelta(days=986)
print(f"End date (986 days later): {end_date.strftime('%A, %B %d, %Y')}")

# Verify the calculation
days_diff = (end_date - start_date).days
print(f"Days difference: {days_diff}")
EOF
</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

The answer is **Thursday**.

986 days after Friday, January 27, 2006 is Thursday, September 30, 2008.
